Een veilige en vredige omgeving
 Nakhon Si Thammarat is over het algemeen een veilige plek om te wonen . Hoewel het diepe zuiden van Thailand te maken heeft gehad met onrust, strekt dat conflict zich niet uit tot deze provincie. Gewelddadige misdrijven tegen buitenlanders komen er uiterst zelden voor.

🏝️ Thailand's most underrated beach city? Nakhon Si Thammarat. 🇹🇭 While most travelers head to Phuket, Krabi, or Koh Samui, Nakhon Si Thammarat remains one of Thailand's best-kept secrets. ❤️ Local prices – Because tourism is still relatively low, restaurants, cafés, and daily living are much more affordable than in Thailand's major tourist destinations. 🌊 One of the most beautiful coastal roads – If you love driving, cycling, or riding a motorbike, you'll enjoy the long seaside road with stunning ocean views, local seafood restaurants, and peaceful beaches along the way. 🌴 A peaceful lifestyle – There are no huge crowds, no crazy nightlife, and very little overdevelopment. It's the perfect place to slow down and enjoy authentic Thailand. 🦐 Some of the best seafood in Thailand – Nakhon Si Thammarat is famous for its incredibly fresh seafood. Many visitors come just for the local restaurants, and it's some of the best I've ever had. 🇹🇭 A truly local destination – Most visitors are Thai, so you'll experience authentic local culture instead of a heavily tourist-focused atmosphere.
